# Getting started {#getting-started}

These short activities show how AI assistants can help with common tasks: understanding documents, checking forms, drafting emails, processing notes and planning activities. We are using **UU AI-Chat** as the university's approved platform.

1. Open **[UU AI-Chat](https://aichat.uu.nl/)** and sign in with your UU account.
2. Use the **Contents** sidebar to choose an activity. Exercises start **collapsed**. Select one from the sidebar or click its title to expand it.
3. Open or download the linked fictional material, then **paste its text or upload the file** where supported. Copy the suggested prompt into UU AI-Chat and inspect the result.

[Optional introductory slides](slides/UU_AI_Chat_Admin_Intro.pptx)

All training documents are **fictional**, not official Utrecht University rules or forms. Do not upload real confidential, personal, or sensitive records without the necessary permission and data-protection checks. Check AI responses against the original sources before using them.

| Understand and check documents | [1. Decode a guide](#exercise-1-decode-administrative-instructions) · [2. Review a form](#exercise-2-review-a-completed-form) · [5. Compare procedures](#exercise-5-compare-two-versions-of-a-procedure) · [6. Create an FAQ](#exercise-6-turn-a-procedure-into-an-faq) |
| Communicate | [3. Write an email](#exercise-3-draft-or-improve-an-email) · [7. Translate a message](#exercise-7-translate-and-simplify-a-message) |
| Organise work | [4. Process meeting notes](#exercise-4-process-meeting-notes) · [8. Plan an event](#exercise-8-plan-a-departmental-event) · [9. Check a spreadsheet](#exercise-9-check-a-simple-spreadsheet) |
| Personalise | [10. Try your own task](#exercise-10-bring-your-own-task) |
| Make it reusable | [11. Saved Prompt](#exercise-11-save-a-prompt-for-repeated-emails) · [12. Persona](#exercise-12-build-a-reusable-form-reviewer-persona) · [13. Project](#exercise-13-use-a-project-across-separate-chats) |

::: {.callout-tip appearance="minimal"}
**UU AI-Chat features at a glance**

**Chat** handles a one-off task; **saved Prompts** reuse instructions; **Personas** reuse an assistant's working method or reference material; **Projects** keep related chats and files together. These features assist work—they do not automatically send emails, approve forms or change university systems.
:::

# Wrap-up and discussion

**Which repetitive or time-consuming tasks would you most like AI to help with?** Which parts could be assisted with a chat or reusable setup, and which would still require your judgement, university system access or formal authorisation?

For more information: [UU AI platforms](https://www.uu.nl/en/organisation/ai-policy/ai-platforms) · [UU guidance for employees](https://www.uu.nl/en/organisation/ai-policy/employees).

These examples demonstrate assistance with work, **not automatic approval or compliance verification**. Keep sensitive information out unless the intended use is authorised.
